mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Rooted in worship and prayer, we connect churches and serve communities through gatherings, training, and shared mission. We seek God together, build unity across generations and cultures, and raise up lives for His purposes.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body1: To become a multi-cultural, multi-generational network, cultivating a lifestyle of worship and prayer while building a spiritual home together.
vision.body2: We connect believers across the East Coast and beyond, seeking God through worship and prayer to walk in His calling and renew this generation.

about.title: About Us
about.body: We are a multicultural, multilingual NGO focused on community care and cross-cultural service, advancing education, care, and renewal through long-term initiatives.

prayer.title: Prayer Room
prayer.body: We offer companionship and intercession for those in need. You are welcome to join by appointment or in person.
